trigger: Police want to search my home
description: What to do if officers come to search your house or apartment.

steps.text: Stay calm. Do not obstruct the officers, but do not invite them in without asking questions.
Your home and privacy are protected (s.37). Ask politely: 'Do you have a search warrant?'
If they have a warrant, ask to read it. Check the address, what they are looking for, and who signed it.
If they have no warrant, ask on what legal authority they are searching. Say you do not consent, but do not physically resist.
Stay present and watch the search. Do not sign anything you have not read.
Write down what was searched, what was taken, and the officers' names and numbers.
Call your lawyer or a trusted person to come now.
